item.title: Overnight SR-78 lane closures in Escondido this week
item.description: Caltrans will close all lanes between SR-78 and I-15 North Broadway in Escondido from 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. on Wednesday and Thursday to conduct pavement rehabbing.

item.title: Coronado Mahjong Club cultivates island community
item.description: The Coronado Mahjong club was founded in April 2025 and has grown to nearly 200 members, providing a welcoming environment for people to learn the centuries-old tile game.

item.title: How to see the rare blood moon eclipse tonight in San Diego
item.description: San Diegans can witness the total lunar eclipse, or blood moon, in the early morning of March 3, with the next one happening in 2028.

item.title: San Diego Humane Society prepares for annual baby shower
item.description: The San Diego Humane Society is preparing to welcome thousands of orphaned wildlife during its busy baby season.

item.title: San Diego city council to vote on proposed empty homes tax
item.description: The San Diego City Council is considering a tax measure targeting homes that sit vacant for most of the year, which could generate between $12 million and $23 million in 2027 if approved by voters.

item.title: Fire breaks out at Caribe Restaurant & Bar in Bonita strip mall
item.description: Fire crews responded to a commercial fire at the Caribe Restaurant & Bar in the Bonnie Brae Center on Bonita Road Monday afternoon.

item.title: Person struck, killed while trying to cross highway in Oceanside
item.description: A person was struck and killed by a vehicle while attempting to cross Highway 76 in Oceanside late Sunday night.

item.title: Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve reopens
item.description: Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve has reopened after a four-month closure for construction.

item.title: 6 troops dead in Iran operation, US military says in update
item.description: The death toll among U.S. service members has risen, the military says.
